fields.options: Upload a spreadsheet with columns ID, azzir_alias_codes.code, azzir_alias_codes.is_primary, azzir_alias_codes.source, and optionally item_name, item_group, stock_uom (only used when creating new items). Use Dry Run first to preview, then Run Import to apply (runs in the background). For each item its code table is replaced; the item's own code stays Primary so nothing is renamed.

fields.label: Sheet / Tab Name
fields.description: Worksheet name in the file (defaults to the first sheet if not found).

fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Replace: match items by ID (exact code). Reconcile: match by ANY code and rename the item to its Primary code (fixes items that were manually renamed).

fields.label: Create Missing Items
fields.description: Replace mode only. If an ID in the file doesn't match any existing item, create it with that ID as its Item Code instead of skipping it.

fields.label: Default Item Group
fields.description: Used for a new item when the file has no item_group column/value for it.

fields.label: Default Stock UOM
fields.description: Used for a new item when the file has no stock_uom column/value for it.

fields.label: Not-Updated Report (CSV)
fields.description: Download to see every item/code that was skipped (missing or conflict).
